# Compute two differential comparisons using t-tests
# Comp1: CohortAsi vs CohortActrl (within Micro context)
# Comp2: CohortBsi vs CohortBctrl (within CohortB context)
cohort_a_ctrl_idx <- c(2, 3, 4)  # CohortActrl1, CohortActrl2, CohortActrl4

cohort_b_si_idx   <- c(11, 12, 13) # CohortBsi1, CohortBsi2, CohortBsi3
# Get expression matrix (log2 values already in the data)
mat <- as.matrix(expr[, -1])
rownames(mat) <- expr$id
# Compute log2FC and p-values for each comparison
compute_diff <- function(mat, idx1, idx2) {
  g1 <- mat[, idx1, drop = FALSE]
  g2 <- mat[, idx2, drop = FALSE]
  mean1 <- rowMeans(g1, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean2 <- rowMeans(g2, na.rm = TRUE)
  log2fc <- mean2 - mean1  # si - ctrl
  # t-test per row
  pvals <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) {
    x <- row[idx1]; y <- row[idx2]
    if (sd(x) == 0 && sd(y) == 0) return(1)
    tryCatch(t.test(x, y)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  })
  data.frame(
    id = rownames(mat),
    log2FoldChange = log2fc,
    pvalue = pvals,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

compute_diff <- function(mat, idx1, idx2) {

  mean1 <- rowMeans(g1, na.rm = TRUE)

  })

    id = rownames(mat),
    log2FoldChange = log2fc,
    pvalue = pvals,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Build the diagonal volcano plot

# Significance thresholds
p_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut <- 1.0  # |log2FC| >= 1
# Compute -log10(p)
diff_res$neg_log10_p_cohort_a <- -log10(pmax(diff_res$pvalue_cohort_a, 1e-300))
diff_res$neg_log10_p_cohort_b <- -log10(pmax(diff_res$pvalue_cohort_b, 1e-300))
# Classify each gene in each comparison
classify <- function(p, lfc) {
  sig <- p < p_cut
  up <- sig & lfc >= lfc_cut
  down <- sig & lfc <= -lfc_cut
  ns <- !sig | abs(lfc) < lfc_cut
  out <- rep("NS", length(p))
  out[up]   <- "Up"
  out[down] <- "Down"
  out
}
diff_res$status_cohort_a <- classify(diff_res$pvalue_cohort_a, diff_res$log2FC_cohort_a)
diff_res$status_cohort_b <- classify(diff_res$pvalue_cohort_b, diff_res$log2FC_cohort_b)
# Diagonal category (the "diagonal volcano" twist): classify genes by their joint status
diff_res$joint <- with(diff_res, ifelse(
  status_cohort_a == "NS" & status_cohort_b == "NS", "NS",
  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Up"   & status_cohort_b == "Up",   "Both Up",
  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Down" & status_cohort_b == "Down",  "Both Down",
  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Up"   & status_cohort_b == "Down",  "CohortA Up / CohortB Down",
  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Down" & status_cohort_b == "Up",    "CohortA Down / CohortB Up",
  "CohortA only"))))))
cat("Joint classification:\n")
print(table(diff_res$joint))
# Set factor levels (specific color order)

diff_res$joint <- factor(diff_res$joint, levels = joint_levels)
# Pick top genes for labeling

# Compute log2FC and t-test p-values for both sub-comparisons
compute_diff <- function(mat, idx1, idx2) {

  })
  data.frame(id = rownames(mat), log2FoldChange = log2fc, pvalue = pvals,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Significance thresholds
p_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut <- 0.5  # |log2FC| >= 0.5
classify <- function(p, lfc) {
  sig <- p < p_cut
  up <- sig & lfc >= lfc_cut
  down <- sig & lfc <= -lfc_cut
  out <- rep("NS", length(p))
  out[up]   <- "Up"
  out[down] <- "Down"
  out
}
diff_res$status_cohort_a <- classify(diff_res$pvalue_cohort_a, diff_res$log2FC_cohort_a)
diff_res$status_cohort_b <- classify(diff_res$pvalue_cohort_b, diff_res$log2FC_cohort_b)

  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Down" & status_cohort_b == "Down",  "Both Down",
  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Up"   & status_cohort_b == "Down",  "CohortA Up / CohortB Down",
  ifelse(status_cohort_a == "Down" & status_cohort_b == "Up",    "CohortA Down / CohortB Up",
  "Single sig"))))))
cat("Joint classification (p<0.05, |LFC|>=0.5):\n")
print(table(diff_res$joint))

joint_colors <- c(
  "NS"             = "grey75",
  "CohortA only"       = "#4F81BD",
  "CohortB only"       = "#F79646",
  "Up in both"     = "#C00000",
  "Down in both"   = "#1F497D",
  "CohortA↑ CohortB↓"      = "#7030A0",
  "CohortA↓ CohortB↑"      = "#E36F1E"
)
cohort_a_top <- diff_res[order(diff_res$neg_log10_p_cohort_a * abs(diff_res$log2FC_cohort_a), decreasing = TRUE), ][1:3, ]
cohort_b_top <- diff_res[order(diff_res$neg_log10_p_cohort_b * abs(diff_res$log2FC_cohort_b), decreasing = TRUE), ][1:3, ]
top_to_label <- unique(rbind(cohort_a_top, cohort_b_top))
# Build the CohortA volcano
v_cohort_a <- ggplot(diff_res, aes(x = log2FC_cohort_a, y = neg_log10_p_cohort_a)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = joint), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = top_to_label, aes(x = log2FC_cohort_a, y = neg_log10_p_cohort_a),
             color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "yellow", stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = top_to_label, aes(x = log2FC_cohort_a, y = neg_log10_p_cohort_a, label = id),
            vjust = -1.1, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = joint_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4.5, 4.5), breaks = seq(-4, 4, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), breaks = seq(0, 6, 1)) +
  labs(title = "CohortAsi vs CohortActrl", x = expression(log[2]~"FC (CohortA)"),
       y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        legend.position = "none",
        aspect.ratio = 0.85)
# Build the CohortB volcano
v_cohort_b <- ggplot(diff_res, aes(x = log2FC_cohort_b, y = neg_log10_p_cohort_b)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = joint), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = top_to_label, aes(x = log2FC_cohort_b, y = neg_log10_p_cohort_b),
             color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "yellow", stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = top_to_label, aes(x = log2FC_cohort_b, y = neg_log10_p_cohort_b, label = id),
            vjust = -1.1, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = joint_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "Joint status",
                     labels = levels(diff_res$joint)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4.5, 4.5), breaks = seq(-4, 4, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), breaks = seq(0, 6, 1)) +
  labs(title = "CohortBsi vs CohortBctrl", x = expression(log[2]~"FC (CohortB)"),
       y = expression(-log[10]~italic(P))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        aspect.ratio = 0.85)
# Build a category-count summary data frame for the bottom panel
counts <- as.data.frame(table(diff_res$joint))
colnames(counts) <- c("Category", "Count")
counts$Category <- factor(as.character(counts$Category), levels = joint_levels)
counts$Label <- paste0(counts$Category, "\nn = ", counts$Count)
summary_plot <- ggplot(counts, aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", Count)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = joint_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Joint category counts",
       x = NULL, y = "Number of genes") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        aspect.ratio = 0.45,
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))
# Final composite layout
combined <- (v_cohort_a + v_cohort_b) /
  summary_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2.4, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot — Joint siRNA Effects in CohortA vs CohortB",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Welch t-test (two-sided), p < %.2f and |log2FC| ≥ %.1f  |  %d genes  |  %d significant in at least one context",
      p_cut, lfc_cut, nrow(diff_res),
      sum(diff_res$joint != "NS")
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
    )
  )
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", combined, width = 13, height = 9.5, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png (13 x 9.5 in @ 200 dpi)\n")
file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")$size
